component.name: Tessera
component.summary: Make photo collages, convert and compress images

description.p: Tessera is a creative photo collage studio and an image Swiss Army knife. A tessera is a single tile of a mosaic — and every photo is one.

ul.li: Quick automatic collages from any number of photos, with eight layout engines including the classic PhotoCollage column layout, mosaics, hearts and other shapes, rings and scattered polaroids
Regenerate until you love the arrangement, drag photos to re-centre them or to swap them
Hand-crafted designs with text, curved text, stickers, shapes, photo frames, borders, shadows and filters
Templates for Valentine’s Day, Christmas, New Year, birthdays, weddings, babies, travel and more
Paper sizes such as A4 and US Letter at print resolution, or social media sizes
Save to JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF or PDF with one click
Convert between formats while keeping all metadata, or only the date, camera and other fields you choose
Keep 100% of the quality, or lower it by the percentage you pick
Smart compression that makes files much smaller while staying visually identical

screenshot.caption: Automatic collage with the layout engines
Smart image compression with before/after preview

description.p: Camera RAW files from most cameras open in collages, the converter and the compressor; wide-gamut photos are converted to sRGB through their ICC profile, or keep their profile if you prefer.
Photos arranged into letters, numbers and words; a golden-spiral layout; month calendars with marked days and photo-calendar templates; 25 new templates and a second sticker pack.
First alpha release: collage editor with layouts, templates, text, stickers and shapes; image converter and compressor.
